steps.label: async ALWAYS RETURNS A PROMISE
steps.sub: Even a plain return value gets wrapped

caption: An async function's return value is always wrapped in a resolved promise — async/await is sugar over promises, not a replacement for them.
Awaiting three calls one by one would run them in sequence — Promise.all still runs them together.
